name: singlet_normalization_size_factor_estimation
title: Per-cell size factor estimation
description: Estimates one positive size factor per cell from raw counts and writes obs/size_factor (plus a log-scale standard error for nb_mle and learned_library); the default is pooled deconvolution and library_size is the fast fallback. Use it before log-normalization, count-based differential expression or any step that needs a per-cell scale; optional cluster labels in obs improve pooling. Do not use it on normalized or log-transformed matrices, to remove ambient RNA or to choose cells; for per-gene residuals use the variance-stabilizing transform task. Call with dry_run true first on large datasets.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

layer.description: Count layer to read; must hold raw non-negative counts (cells by genes), not normalized or log-transformed values.

method.description: library_size: total counts; pooled: pooled deconvolution (default); median_ratio: DESeq-style median of ratios; nb_mle: per-cell negative-binomial maximum likelihood (proposed); learned_library: scVI latent library size.

scale_convention.description: Global constant fixing the scale: median factor 1, mean over positive factors 1, mean log factor 0, or scanpy-style median non-zero total.

clusters_key.description: obs column of rough cluster labels for pooled and nb_mle; must not derive from the normalized output. Null lets pooled cluster internally.

exclude_mask.description: var column (boolean) of genes excluded from estimation for every method, for example highly expressed genes. Null uses all genes.

pooled.description: Options for method pooled and the pooled initialisation of nb_mle; defaults follow scuttle.

sizes.description: Pool window sizes; each size adds one set of pool equations. The smallest window should be at least 20 for UMI data.

max_cluster_size.description: Maximum cells per linear system; larger clusters are split before solving.

min_mean.description: Minimum library-size-adjusted mean of genes used. Null picks 0.1 or 1 from the median library size.

positive.description: Replace non-positive estimates by values predicted from detected-gene counts and warn. When false, they raise an error.

ref_cluster.description: Reference cluster for rescaling clusters to one another. Null uses the cluster with the most non-zero pseudo-cell entries.

prescale_rounds.description: Number of pooling rounds; each later round prescales by the previous factors. Round one prescales by library size.

quickcluster_min_size.description: Minimum cluster size for internal clustering when clusters_key is null.

quickcluster_use_ranks.description: Cluster on ranks instead of log-expression, which avoids circularity with the normalization being estimated.

type.description: ratio uses genes positive in every cell and errors if none exist; poscounts takes geometric means over positive counts.

seed.description: Random seed; used only by learned_library training.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing size factor members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/size_factor. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs: method, scale_convention, n_cells, size_factor_min, size_factor_median, size_factor_max, n_coerced_nonpositive, min_mean_applied, median_log_se, warnings. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
